_README: THE ONE PLACE for the Microsoft Store package identity. Copy these two values from Partner Center > your app > Product management > Product identity (Package/Identity/Name and Package/Identity/Publisher), exactly as shown there. They are invisible to users and can never change after the first submission. The publisher's DISPLAY name (SpaceZ) and every other visible name come from spike_app/brand.json (publisherDisplayName must match Partner Center's 'Package/Properties/PublisherDisplayName'). See software/app/store/PARTNER_CENTER_CHECKLIST.md.
_localTestPublisher: Used only by build_msix.ps1 -LocalTest: a test package for a PC in Developer Mode, installed from its staged folder with Add-AppxPackage -Register build\msix\stage\AppxManifest.xml (no certificate needed). Never uploaded.
